why: THE CANVAS IS THE DESIGN (P6.e, 2026-09-20). Every figure is a value the vetted read tools returned on 2026-09-20; the blocks, arrangement and words are the session's, cut to ops/ideal/how-are-we-doing-v2.html: a one-line head per block, the figure's thought under its number, the span's on the chart. NO MODEL TURN WAS SPENT.
question: how are we doing?
answer:
Down on the month - but **the fall was two weeks in August, at every shop, and it is over - except at Rockwell.**

Same number of people, smaller baskets. The range is splitting: a few lines stopped dead while a few others took off. And eight lines hit zero yesterday, most of them at OPUS and Magnolia.

Shall I draft the eight transfers, and pull Rockwell day by day across those two weeks?

…and each spent less, at all seven shops.

blocks.question: Crossed to zero yesterday.
blocks.thought: No low-stock level is set anywhere, so this is the first I see of any of them.
Its shelf feed has not moved since 5 August, so its quiet means nothing either way.
